text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright is being interviewed for a
magazine
today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You look fantastic in your signature
racewear.
Were you particular about any
aspects of the
design?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Aspects of the design? Well... I would
have to say
this skirt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The seamstress crafted it precisely the
way I
wanted, and I'm ever so
grateful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright beam as she
discusses her
signature racewear reminds
me of the day it
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone. I went with this design.
May I ask
for your thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, picture perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it suits you nicely, Bright. The big
puffy
sleeves, the high-waisted skirt, all
of it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's lively and cute. I know I wouldn't be
able to
pull a design like that off myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't say that, Dober. Of course you
would.
As would Ryan as well. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If, for instance, you were to don
something like
this, Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps a crimson dress adorned with
frills and
lace? And with a nice
headdress for good
measure. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Dah! H-hey! Stop! As if something so
flashy would
look good on me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Although, I must admit that it's cute. And if you insist, Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And how about this ensemble for you,
Ryan? To
start with...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
An ample, frilly blouse coupled with a
pinafore
dress would surely suit you very
nicely indeed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa whoa, hold on! That kind of
outfit's not
really my thing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
But, um... It's not like I don't care, yeah?
Uhh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway! That signature racewear's
great. It
really brings out your best side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That skirt's especially striking. Maybe it's
all that
bright teal-green?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! Yes, I suppose it does stand
out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, though, you were the
inspiration
behind this skirt, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I was?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Well, when I was still quite young, I had
difficulty
keeping up with everyone and
came to be
considered an
underachiever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And yet, you took my hand and ran
alongside me,
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I was by no means a fast runner at the
time, but
you ran and ran with me, all
around the training
center.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The excitement that welled up within me
back
then is a cornerstone of who I am
today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The teal-green of my skirt is the same as
that of
the lush scenery that surrounded
us at the training
center that day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The scenery of my memory with you,
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I have trained hard since then, both by
honing my
skills with Dober and under
my trainer's
tutelage...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And now here I am, honoring the Mejiro
family
tradition by dressing in green and
white signature
racewear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Ryan, please allow me to use this
opportunity
to express my gratitude for
all you've done for
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So you put all that thought into it...
Hehe, maybe
that's why your skirt struck
a chord with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: There's this skirt, and one more thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
A sign of our bond—passed down from
you to me
and Dober, which we now
share in our legs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Clad in my very esteem for you, Ryan, I
shall
become the light of the Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! I can't wait to see you
barrel
down the track in that racewear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I mean to win as well, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
One final question for you, Mejiro
Bright. Would
you mind sharing a little
about the inspiration
behind your
racewear design?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Inspiration, you ask? Well... Um...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright struggle to answer,
I find
myself unable to just sit back and
watch her
squirm.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. In that case, we'll call it
there. Thank
you for your time and your
answers. I have a good
feeling about this
article.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer. About what just
transpired at
the interview...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why do you think I found myself
tongue-tied with
that last question?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Why do you think I found myself
tongue-tied with
that last question?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. How wonderful it is that we
think along
the same lines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I believe that my memories are best kept
out of
the public eye until I'm ready to
proudly bear the
Mejiro mantle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And we've yet to reach that point in our
journey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I wish for you to remain at my
side until
that glorious day arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After reaffirming our vision for the
future, Mejiro
Bright and I vow once
again to make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My! So you were able to accurately
intuit how I
felt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ah... But today's not the first time, is it?
You've
always understood my feelings
and offered me
support.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Let us join hands and continue down this
path at
our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I once again ask for your wisdom
and
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel like my bond with Mejiro Bright
has grown
even stronger.
